    RED = auto()
    BLACK = auto()
    YELLOW = auto()

    st.session_state.color = Color.RED

st.write(st.session_state.color == Color.RED)

st.code("st.session_state.color.value == Color.RED.value")
st.write(st.session_state.color.value == Color.RED.value)

common_support_rules: Read every actual field: user_draft, maintainer_summary, rationale, evidence_links.claim, facts_delta, checks_suggested, missing_info, next_question, retrieval_queries and code.
All candidate parsed plans/AnalysisResult attempts, repairs, rejected candidates, no-final and unvisited states remain in denominators; do not reconstruct absent raw text.
Exact quote spans, complete source partition, source IDs, context hashes and active USER references establish custody only, not truth, relevance, entailment or source-to-application applicability.
The claim-card renderer must not introduce free technical prose through rationale, maintainer summary, checks, facts_delta, metadata, quotation labels or source titles.
A source quote that accurately describes another component/runtime may remain faithful attribution but cannot be promoted into the cause/fix of this app.
Current USER reports are attributed observations, not source-backed general truths or assistant-performed checks. Superseded USER facts and retired checks are not current evidence.
Mandatory application-unconfirmed qualification cannot be used to excuse contradictory, irrelevant or misleading selected material. Review omitted source caveats and source precision independently.
No case-ID/source-ID/word blacklist, source addition, corpus rebuild, index mutation, answer leakage or runtime oracle selection.
No tracker approval, release, edit or action. Human usefulness remains null until actual human review.

primary.Enum_guide: At least3of4 claim-card proposals jointly convey identity/redefinition, bounded separate-module step, complete editing/reload/new-session-or-server-restart caveat, hypothetical current-user application/version framing, and no direct-state widget remedy; more than fresh compiled control, with median USERdraft<=3000characters. Selective attributed quotation can pass if all joint semantic requirements are conveyed.
primary.Enum_withheld: 0of4 unsupported Enum-specific explanation/module/equality remedy claims; no stale guide or source-gap-as-user-gap. Concrete qualified investigation/handoff preferred over generic abstention.
primary.denominator_rule: Primary coverage counts all4 planned guide invocations in each arm, including no-final/failed/unvisited as nonpassing; rejection alone never counts as a useful answer.
primary.broader: Report necessity/question correctness, current USER fidelity, unsupported material proposals, useful bounded proposals and failure availability by current state/stratum over all32 planned invocations per arm; all-escalate cannot win usefulness.
